facts.fact_text: On 2 April 2011 the first applicant attended an unauthorised opposition demonstration held at Fountains Square in Baku.
On 2 April 2011 the second applicant attended an unauthorised opposition demonstration held at Fountains Square in Baku.
The demonstration held at Fountains Square on 2 April 2011 was intended to be peaceful.
The demonstration held at Fountains Square on 2 April 2011 was conducted in a peaceful manner.
Upon arriving at Fountains Square at around 3 p.m. on 2 April 2011, the first applicant was arrested by police officers.
The first applicant was allegedly beaten by S.N., who was the Deputy Head of the Nasimi district police office.
The first applicant was allegedly beaten by a police officer called J.A.
The first applicant was allegedly beaten by a person wearing plain clothes whom the first applicant did not know.
According to the first applicant, despite his requests, he was not provided with the requisite medical assistance while in police custody.
The judge of the Nasimi District Court disregarded the first applicant's requests to have a lawyer of his own choice and to invite witnesses to testify on his behalf.
The Nasimi District Court found that the first applicant had failed to stop participating in an unauthorised demonstration.
The Nasimi District Court sentenced the first applicant to eight days' administrative detention.
The Nasimi District Court convicted the first applicant under Article 310.1 (failure to comply with a lawful order of a police officer) of the Code of Administrative Offences.
The relevant domestic law concerning the prohibition of ill-treatment is summarised in the case of Mustafa Hajili v. Azerbaijan (no. 42119/12, paragraphs 26-28, 24 November 2016).
The relevant domestic law concerning administrative proceedings and freedom of assembly is summarised in the case of Gafgaz Mammadov v. Azerbaijan (no. 60259/11, paragraphs 27-39, 15 October 2015).

The relevant domestic law concerning administrative proceedings and freedom of assembly is summarised in the case of Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, paragraphs 56-66, 11 February 2016).

The second applicant was reprimanded for participating in a public assembly under Article 298 (violation of the rules on holding public assemblies) of the Code of Administrative Offences.
